lines: Sharp & Son, you're through to the AI assistant on this demo line. Who are you booking with?
Sharp & Son: Traditional barbering and wet shaves, at 3 Mill Yard (example), Kirkhill.
Tuesday to Friday: 8:30am till 5:30pm. Saturday: 8:30am till 2pm. Closed Monday and Sunday.
Barbers: Ray (forty years with the razor); Tom.
A £10 deposit secures a booking and comes off the price. Free to cancel or move with 48 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
3 services on the price list, booked with 2 barbers.
